learnings: The audit tool's XML parser should be more robust against minor LLM hallucinations in tag names (e.g., <security_ass游戏副本>) by using regex fallbacks to extract the <decision> tag regardless of the parent tag's exact spelling.
If a file verdict fails to parse due to formatting errors, the tool could automatically retry just that file or extract the decision from the raw text if a clear SAFE/UNSAFE keyword is present.
